The fastest route to travel to Zalcano is by using a [[teleport crystal]] or its [[Eternal teleport crystal|eternal counterpart]]. Other ways include using a spirit tree to [[Prifddinas]] or a [[teleport to house]] with your house location in Prifddinas or a [[scroll of redirection]] on a [[teleport to house (tablet)|tablet]].
